summary: The Indian women's hockey team secured a dominant 6-2 victory over China in the Asian Champions Trophy, with Deepika scoring a hat-trick, ensuring their spot in the semifinals with a flawless group stage performance.

title: Priyansh Arya's Record-Breaking Day for Delhi in SMAT 2026
indian_angle: Priyansh Arya's historic T20 innings for Delhi, featuring a record-breaking score and joint-most sixes, eliminated Tamil Nadu from the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy Super League race.
summary: Priyansh Arya of Delhi made history in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy 2026, achieving the highest individual T20 score by an Indian and equaling the record for most sixes in an innings, leading Delhi to victory.

title: Sooryavanshi Smashes Fastest List A Double-Century for India A

summary: In the Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026, India A defeated UAE by seven wickets, highlighted by Sooryavanshi's spectacular performance, smashing the fastest List A double-century.

title: IOA Presidential Race: Gagan Narang, Mehta, Sachdeva in Three-Way Contest

summary: The Indian Olympic Association's presidential election is set for a three-way contest between Gagan Narang, Rajeev Mehta, and Virender Sachdeva, following PT Usha's withdrawal from the race.
